items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Zooty Singleton' and asks 'we know him', but the interviewee only responds to the subsequent question about 'Black Benny', stating 'I used to play with Black Benny too'. There is no direct statement from the interviewee confirming a personal relationship with Zooty.

ctx.x: Oh, he was up in California, up in Nugganuga. You know, you know, Zooty? Oh, Zooty, is that Singleton maybe? Singleton. Zooty Singleton. Zooty Singleton. His uncle was Willie Bontop. Yeah, that's his uncle. Yeah, we know him. What about Black Benny? How was he? Did you hear him? Oh, I used to play with Black Benny too, yeah. Did he play snare drums or was that always bass? What did he do?
Oh, yeah. He played trap, saying he played bass drums too. He was a hell of a bass drum man.
